name: Core order-domain query
purpose: Read one production order with its route and visits, lots, serialized components and the equipment references the route needs.
authority_level: Core domain read; no command, approval or execution authority
security_classification: Internal manufacturing-domain metadata; no credentials or Oracle labels

semantics.revision: Opaque nonblank per-entity revisions are preserved; there is no numeric comparison, aggregate revision, freshness guarantee or global snapshot.
semantics.ordering: Lots, components and equipment are ordered by identity in Unicode code-point order; route visits keep their semantic traversal order.
semantics.errors: ORDER_NOT_FOUND, MISSING_ROUTE and MISSING_EQUIPMENT; invalid structure raises a validation error.
